import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Только заказы, совершённые до seed_time
    orders_before = orders.loc[
        orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time,
        ["order_id", "customer_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ]

    # Позиции заказов: используем ts (момент покупки) для фильтрации
    items_before = order_items.loc[order_items["ts"] <= seed_time,
                                   ["order_id", "product_id", "price", "freight_value", "ts"]]

    merged = items_before.merge(orders_before, on="order_id", how="inner")

    # Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к моменту seed_time
    reviews_before = reviews.loc[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time,
                                 ["order_id", "review_score"]]
    review_agg = reviews_before.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].agg(
        ["mean", "count"]).reset_index()
    review_agg.columns = ["order_id", "review_score_mean", "review_count"]

    # Платежи: только те, что известны к моменту seed_time
    payments = payments.copy()
    payments["is_credit"] = (payments["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(int)
    payments_before = payments.loc[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
    payment_agg = payments_before.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        payment_value_mean=("payment_value", "mean"),
        payment_value_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        credit_card_share=("is_credit", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    merged = merged.merge(review_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    merged = merged.merge(payment_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    merged["days_since_order"] = (seed_time - merged["ts"]).dt.days.clip(lower=0)
    merged["revenue"] = merged["price"] + merged["freight_value"]

    grouped = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
        count_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        count_items=("order_id", "count"),
        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        sum_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        total_revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score_mean", "mean"),
        count_reviews=("review_count", "sum"),
        payment_count_mean=("payment_count", "mean"),
        payment_value_mean=("payment_value_mean", "mean"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments_mean", "mean"),
        credit_card_share=("credit_card_share", "mean"),
        days_since_last_order=("days_since_order", "min"),
        days_since_first_order=("days_since_order", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    for days in [30, 90, 180]:
        tmp = merged[merged["days_since_order"] <= days].groupby("product_id").agg(
            **{f"count_orders_{days}d": ("order_id", "nunique"),
               f"count_items_{days}d": ("order_id", "count"),
               f"revenue_{days}d": ("revenue", "sum"),
               f"unique_customers_{days}d": ("customer_id", "nunique")}
        ).reset_index()
        grouped = grouped.merge(tmp, on="product_id", how="left")

    grouped["active_period"] = grouped["days_since_first_order"] - grouped["days_since_last_order"]
    grouped["order_frequency"] = np.where(
        grouped["active_period"] > 0,
        grouped["count_orders"] / grouped["active_period"],
        0
    )

    # Тренд: отношение продаж за последние 30 дней к предыдущим 60
    grouped["trend_30_90"] = grouped["count_orders_30d"] / grouped["count_orders_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    grouped["trend_30_90"] = grouped["trend_30_90"].fillna(0)

    grouped = grouped.fillna(0)
    grouped = grouped.set_index("product_id")

    result = grouped.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    return result
